LESSON: CIRCLES

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Measurements
Topic 3.1: Circles
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Circles, part of Measurements in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: How do we determine the circumference of a circle? 2. How do we use sectors of a circle in real life situations?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and find the circumference of different circular objects in the environment. Those with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication- AAC. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task.

2. use large cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss in purposive pairs or groups and find the circumference of different circular objects in the environment. Those with speech difficulties could use Alternative and Augmentative modes of Communication- AAC. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, appropriate assistive devices or be assisted by peers or teacher to perform the task.
2. use large cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Circles together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: as the learner discusses and finds the circumference of different circular objects in the

environment.

• Creativity and imagination: as the learner uses cut outs to relate arc length to the circumference of a circle.

Values

• Integrity: as the learner draws circles of given dimensions and work out the circumference of a circle.

• Responsibility: as the learner makes any objects with the sector that can be used in real life situations.
